description: This file defines the HistogramAggregator class, which is responsible for collecting and aggregating histogram data, including recording values, collecting bucket measurements, counts, and sums within the Orleans runtime project.

classes.name: HistogramAggregator
classes.description: A class that aggregates histogram data by maintaining buckets, counts, and sums, providing methods to record data and collect measurements.

methods.name: HistogramAggregator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the histogram with specified buckets, tags, and label generator.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Method to record a data point into the appropriate histogram bucket, updating count and sum atomically.

methods.name: CollectBuckets
methods.description: Collects measurements for each histogram bucket.

methods.name: CollectCount
methods.description: Collects the total count of recorded data points.

methods.name: CollectSum
methods.description: Collects the sum of all recorded data points.
